name: fixed
done: fixed stores the pattern text and case_insensitive.
case: fixed("a.b"), ignore_case TRUE, c("abb", "a.b"), NA, TRUE, FALSE, NULL, and character(0)

name: coll
done: coll stores locale en and strength 3, or strength 2 when ignore_case is true, unless strength is passed.
case: coll("a") at locale en and strength 3, ignore_case strength 2, strength 1, locale tr, numeric TRUE, strength NULL, and strength NA

name: regex
done: regex stores case_insensitive, comments, dotall, and multiline.
case: regex("a.b"), ignore_case TRUE, all four flags TRUE, time_limit 10, and dot_all which leaves dotall FALSE

name: boundary
done: boundary stores a length-1 NA, type character with skip_word_none false, and word boundaries set skip_word_none true.
case: boundary() type character skip_word_none FALSE, boundary("word") skip_word_none TRUE, sentence, line_break, explicit skips, and locale tr
